Class ItemModification

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.item.ItemModification
public class ItemModification extends Object
Mutable state for one interactive item operation.

The object captures the item's original geometry and initial mouse position, then tracks the current mouse position in both local and world coordinates while a drag, resize, or rotation is in progress.

  • Constructor Details

    • ItemModification

      public ItemModification(AItem item, IContainer container, Point startMousePoint, Point currentMousePoint, boolean shift, boolean control)
      Create an ItemModification. The type is the default: DRAG. It can be changed via setType.
      Parameters:
      item - the item being modified.
      container - the item's container.
      startMousePoint - the mouse point where the item was grabbed.
      currentMousePoint - the current mouse point.
      shift - was shift pressed when modification began
      control - was control pressed when modification began
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if item or container is null
